text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
As we work toward the BC as a team,
we are required to periodically report our progress
to the URA.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"What's crucial is that 'everyone clears their objective.'
Please do not forget that we are, above all, a team."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: It would be best to decide on a focus and prioritize training according to that focus during this period.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Decide which abilities you want your members to develop and give them instructions accordingly.
Keeping our future racing plans in mind, let's decide the direction to focus on for next season.
